courses.title: Leading SAFe® (SA)
courses.hero_sub: Lead a Lean-Agile transformation by applying SAFe® and its principles of Lean, systems thinking, and agile development. Two days, live-virtual, with an authorised SAFe instructor (SPC/ASPC) — exam included and a money-back pass guarantee.
courses.audience: Executives, managers, and change agents leading an Agile transformation. No prerequisites.
modules: Thriving in the digital age with Business Agility
Why business agility matters and the seven core competencies of the Lean enterprise.
Building a Lean-Agile mindset
The values, principles, and Lean-Agile leadership behaviours that anchor SAFe.
Understanding SAFe principles
Apply the ten immutable principles that underpin every SAFe practice and decision.
Experiencing PI Planning
Run a simulated Program Increment Planning event — the heartbeat of an Agile Release Train.
Releasing value continuously
Build the Continuous Delivery Pipeline and DevOps culture that release on demand.
Leading the transformation
Lead the change with the SAFe Implementation Roadmap and a Lean-Agile Center of Excellence.

courses.title: SAFe® Scrum Master (SSM)
courses.hero_sub: Become the Scrum Master who facilitates Agile teams within a SAFe enterprise — running team and program events, supporting PI execution, and coaching teams to high performance. Two days, live-virtual, exam included.
courses.audience: New and existing Scrum Masters, team leads, and managers working within an Agile Release Train.
modules: Introducing Scrum in SAFe
How Scrum operates in a scaled context and the role of the Scrum Master in SAFe.
Characterizing the role of the Scrum Master
Servant leadership, coaching stances, and the SAFe Scrum Master's responsibilities.
Experiencing PI Planning
Prepare for and facilitate the team's part in Program Increment Planning.
Facilitating iteration execution
Run iteration planning, daily stand-ups, reviews, and retrospectives that stick.
Finishing the PI
Support the System Demo, Inspect & Adapt, and continuous improvement across the train.
Coaching the Agile team
Build high-performing teams and improve flow with relentless improvement.

courses.title: SAFe® Product Owner / Product Manager (POPM)
courses.hero_sub: Master the responsibilities of the Product Owner and Product Manager in a SAFe enterprise — writing stories, managing backlogs, and delivering value through the Continuous Delivery Pipeline. Two days, live-virtual, exam included.
courses.audience: Product Owners, Product Managers, business analysts, and anyone shaping value in an ART.
modules: Analyzing the customer journey
Apply design thinking and customer-centricity to discover real value.
Exploring the Lean-Agile mindset
How POs and PMs apply SAFe principles to maximise value delivery.
Defining needs with the backlog
Write epics, features, and stories and keep a healthy, prioritised backlog.
Preparing for and leading PI Planning
Drive vision, roadmap, and priorities into Program Increment Planning.
Executing the Program Increment
Support iteration execution, demos, and the steady flow of value.
Continuously improving value
Use feedback and metrics to relentlessly improve outcomes.

courses.title: SAFe® for Teams (SP)
courses.hero_sub: Build the skills to be a high-performing member of an Agile Release Train — how to plan and execute work, collaborate across teams, and deliver value in a Program Increment. Two days, live-virtual, exam included.
courses.audience: All members of an Agile team joining or working on an Agile Release Train.
modules: Introducing the Agile Release Train
How teams operate together on an ART to build and deliver value.
Building an Agile team
Roles, events, and artifacts that make a cross-functional Agile team work.
Planning the Iteration
Estimate, plan, and commit to iteration work that ladders up to PI objectives.
Executing the Iteration
Visualise flow, limit WIP, and improve quality with built-in practices.
Executing the Program Increment
Integrate, demo, and align across teams through the PI.
Improving relentlessly
Use Inspect & Adapt to drive continuous improvement.

courses.title: SAFe® Advanced Scrum Master (SASM)
courses.hero_sub: Take your Scrum Master practice to the program level — facilitating cross-team interactions, supporting DevOps and built-in quality, and coaching the Agile Release Train. Two days, live-virtual, exam included.
courses.audience: Experienced Scrum Masters ready to lead at the program and train level.
modules: Exploring the Scrum Master role in SAFe
Scale facilitation and servant leadership across the Agile Release Train.
Applying SAFe principles to facilitation
Use Lean-Agile principles to coach teams and resolve systemic impediments.
Facilitating program execution
Support cross-team coordination, dependencies, and the flow of value.
Improving flow with Kanban and XP
Build in quality with DevOps, Kanban, and engineering practices.
Building high-performing teams
Foster collaboration, conflict resolution, and team maturity.
Leading change as a Scrum Master
Drive relentless improvement and coach the train to excellence.

courses.title: SAFe® Release Train Engineer (RTE)
courses.hero_sub: Become the servant leader and coach of the Agile Release Train — facilitating ART events and processes, driving relentless improvement, and leading the program through PI execution. Three days, live-virtual, exam included. Taught by a certified SPCT.
courses.audience: RTEs, Solution Train Engineers, and program managers facilitating an ART. Prerequisite knowledge of SAFe recommended.
modules: Exploring the RTE role
The servant-leader RTE and how the Agile Release Train operates.
Applying SAFe principles
Use Lean-Agile principles to drive ART performance and flow.
Organizing the Agile Release Train
Design and launch the ART, roles, and cadence.
Planning and executing the PI
Facilitate PI Planning, execution, and the System Demo.
Coaching the ART to relentless improvement
Run Inspect & Adapt and continuously improve the train.
Leading the ART at scale
Coordinate across trains and the Solution Train.

courses.title: SAFe® DevOps (SDP)
courses.hero_sub: Map your Continuous Delivery Pipeline, optimise the flow of value from idea to production, and build the culture, automation, and measurement that release on demand. Two days, live-virtual, exam included.
courses.audience: Anyone involved in delivering value through the Continuous Delivery Pipeline — dev, ops, QA, and management.
modules: Introducing DevOps
The CALMR approach and why DevOps is essential to business agility.
Mapping your Continuous Delivery Pipeline
Value-stream map the pipeline from concept to cash.
Continuous Exploration
Build a hypothesis-driven backlog with design thinking.
Continuous Integration
Develop, build, test, and stage with automation and quality built in.
Continuous Deployment
Deploy and verify to production with low risk and fast recovery.
Release on Demand
Decouple release from deploy and measure value in production.

courses.title: SAFe® Agile Product Management (APM)
courses.hero_sub: Use design thinking and a Lean-Agile mindset to discover, build, and bring to market products customers love — from vision and roadmap to pricing, packaging, and continuous value. Three days, live-virtual, exam included.
courses.audience: Product Managers, Product Owners, and product leaders driving product strategy in SAFe.
modules: Analyzing your role as a Product Manager
Connect strategy to execution as a Lean-Agile Product Manager.

Use desirability, feasibility, viability, and sustainability to find value.
Exploring markets and users
Segment markets, build personas, and validate with real users.
Driving strategy with market rhythms
Plan with market rhythms and events to time value to the market.
Managing the value stream
Prioritise with economics and manage the flow of features.
Delivering value continuously
Price, package, and license; measure and pivot with feedback.

courses.hero_sub: Align strategy and execution by applying Lean and systems thinking to portfolio strategy, funding, and operations — connecting the portfolio to enterprise strategy and Lean budgets. Two days, live-virtual, exam included.

Applying Lean governance
Forecast and budget dynamically, measure portfolio performance.

courses.title: SAFe® Agile Software Engineering (ASE)
courses.hero_sub: Build the technical practices that make continuous delivery real — test-first, behaviour-driven development, and Agile architecture that lets teams release on demand with built-in quality. Three days, live-virtual, exam included.
courses.audience: Developers, engineers, architects, and technical leads building software in a SAFe enterprise.

Sharpen the SPC toolkit for complex, multi-ART transformations.
